title: BUEM GeoJSON Response Schema (API contract v6-draft)
description: Response schema for the BUEM building energy model. Echoes the request structure and adds thermal_load_profile and model_metadata to each feature's buem node. All output quantities carry explicit unit fields. Timeseries arrays declare their unit once at the array level. Draft, not yet promoted — see v6-draft-contract-backlog for open items, including this file's own hot_water/kitchen additions below.

processing_elapsed_s.description: Total wall-clock time for the full request in seconds

features.description: Array of processed building features with results appended

collection_metadata.description: Aggregate processing statistics for the feature collection

failed_features.description: Number of features that failed processing

validation_warnings.description: Total number of validation warnings across all features

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates [longitude, latitude, elevation?] — echoed from request

start_time.description: Simulation start time — echoed from request

end_time.description: Simulation end time — echoed from request

resolution.description: Time resolution value — echoed from request

resolution_unit.description: Time resolution unit — echoed from request

buem.description: Echoes the request buem node (building, solver, inputs, weather) and appends thermal_load_profile and model_metadata

building.description: Echoed from request — contains name (optional display label), envelope, thermal, and all classification fields

inputs.description: Echoed from request — user-provided timeseries inputs, if any were supplied

weather.description: Echoed from request when present — the resolved hourly timeseries the model ran against

thermal_load_profile.description: Computed thermal load results for the building

start_time.description: First timestamp in the simulation output

end_time.description: Last timestamp in the simulation output

timeseries_file.description: Path of the intermediate .json.gz file buem-model writes when the request sets save_timeseries_file (buem-model 6.4.0 and later). buem-gateway never requests the file, so its responses do not carry this field.

load_summary.description: Aggregated statistics over the full simulation period, one entry per profile the request selected (outputs set to summary or series; every profile when outputs is omitted). A selected profile buem-model cannot produce is reported as all-zero rather than left out: hot_water and kitchen for service building_type, kitchen with electric cooking. peak_heating_load is present when heating is selected and peak_cooling_load when cooling is selected. total_energy_demand is present only when heating, cooling, electricity and hot_water are all selected.

hot_water.description: Domestic hot water useful-heat DEMAND — fuel-agnostic (what the building's systems must deliver, same family as heating/cooling), not literal delivered energy of any one carrier. Included in total_energy_demand below. All-zero for a service building_type (bakery, clinic, hotel, office, restaurant, school, supermarket, warehouse) — BuEM has no hot water model for service buildings, regardless of include_dhw.

kitchen.description: Estimated cooking GAS energy — literal delivered gas (a national heating:cooking ratio proxy, not metered or physically modelled), not a fuel-agnostic demand figure like hot_water. A different fuel carrier from every other field in this summary, marked with its own kWh_gas/kW_gas units for that reason. NOT included in total_energy_demand below — folding a gas quantity into an otherwise thermal/electric total remains an open question. All-zero for a service building_type (bakery, clinic, hotel, office, restaurant, school, supermarket, warehouse) — BuEM has no cooking model for service buildings, regardless of cooking_carrier.

total_energy_demand.description: Sum of heating, cooling, electricity and hot_water over the simulation period, present only when all four are selected so that it always means the same quantity. Does not include kitchen, see its own description.

energy_intensity.description: total_energy_demand divided by building.A_ref. Present when total_energy_demand is present.

energy_summary.description: Statistical summary for one energy carrier over the simulation period

total.description: Total energy over the simulation period

mean.description: Mean power over the simulation period

median.description: Median power over the simulation period

std.description: Standard deviation of power over the simulation period

gas_energy_summary.description: Statistical summary for a GAS energy carrier over the simulation period — same shape as energy_summary, but the quantities carry gas-specific units (kWh_gas/kW_gas) so a consumer can never mistake this for electric or thermal energy.

total.description: Total gas energy over the simulation period

mean.description: Mean gas power over the simulation period

median.description: Median gas power over the simulation period

std.description: Standard deviation of gas power over the simulation period

load_timeseries.description: Hourly timeseries arrays, one per profile the request set to series. unit applies to every array except kitchen, which is gas and carries its own kitchen_unit (same electric/thermal-vs-gas split as load_summary's energy_summary vs gas_energy_summary). kitchen is present only with gas cooking.

unit.description: Unit for the heating, cooling, electricity, and hot_water arrays

kitchen_unit.description: Unit for the kitchen array specifically — gas, never electric or thermal. Present whenever kitchen is.

timestamps.description: ISO 8601 timestamps, one per time step

heating.description: Heating load at each time step

cooling.description: Cooling load at each time step

electricity.description: Electricity consumption at each time step

hot_water.description: Domestic hot water useful-heat energy at each time step. All-zero for a service building_type — see load_summary.hot_water.

kitchen.description: Estimated gas-cooking power at each time step — see kitchen_unit above, not unit. All-zero for a service building_type — see load_summary.kitchen.

model_metadata.description: Diagnostic information about the model run

resolved_inputs.description: The occupancy inputs buem-model actually used for this building, after applying defaults. A field that does not apply to the building_type is null.

num_persons.description: Occupants per dwelling; a fractional value is the statistical mean buem-model blended from two household sizes. null for service building_type.

archetype.description: Household archetype. null for service building_type.

capacity.description: Occupant capacity. null for residential building_type.

solver_used.description: Solver selected for the run (e.g. scipy-sparse, OSQP, CBC)

weather_year.description: Calendar year of the weather data used

validation_warnings.description: Any validation warnings generated during processing

measurement.description: Base type for all measurable quantities. Unit defaults to SI when omitted.

gas_energy_qty.description: Same as energy_qty but explicitly the gas fuel carrier, never electric or thermal.

gas_power_qty.description: Same as power_qty but explicitly the gas fuel carrier, never electric or thermal.
